headline: ATL @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.05 at MIA 3.39, with a projected total of 7.45. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (ATL -0.23, MIA -0.29), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.53, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +16.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Max Meyer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Xavier Edwards, Drake Baldwin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Esteury Ruiz, Ozzie Albies because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
